notes: Every sample is a rifampicin time course (time0 = 3.5 min after rifampicin), so transcription_arrested true and treatment abx_transcription for all; no untreated sample, so is_control left out. Phase mid_exponential kept (all samples within 2 h of rifampicin). MG1693 / SK4455 mapped to K-12 from strain names (organism field only says Escherichia coli).

base_medium.q: Cells were grown to exponential phase in Lysogeny broth, 37oC with shaking

growth_phase.q: Cells were grown to exponential phase in Lysogeny broth

treatment.q: Cells were harvested after the addition of rifampicin  (250 μg/ml) to stop nascent transcription

exposure.q: further samples were taken at 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, and 20 minutes

transcription_arrested.q: after the addition of rifampicin  (250 μg/ml) to stop nascent transcription

inducer_added.q: Examination of RNA-seq read coverage between a strain with and without RNase III throughout time after preventing nascent transcription with rifampicin

mixed_organism.q: Examination of RNA-seq read coverage between a strain with and without RNase III

assay_class.q: rRNA reduction with EpiCentre Ribo-Zero Gram Negative Ribosomal RNA reduction kit

rrna_removal.q: rRNA reduction with EpiCentre Ribo-Zero Gram Negative Ribosomal RNA reduction kit

global_regulator_perturbed.q: a strain with and without RNase III
